items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterizes when the base change map of the trivial duality section is an isomorphism, namely exactly when the corresponding base change map for the derived internal hom is (author lemma at source lines 2695-2706, label lemma-check-base-change-is-iso). The proof (source lines 2708-2723) reduces to testing the map after pushing forward along the base change, identifies the resulting map with the known base change map for the internal hom, and unwinds both sides through the tensor-hom adjunction as in the cited proof (proof lines 2718-2722). The reduction and the unwinding are the substance. H2.
